in_sanskrit.meaning: दया (dayā) - compassion, kindness, love + ल (l) - a particle indicating continuity

in_marathi.name: Dayaal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dayaal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dayaal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'daya' which means 'compassion' or 'mercy'. This name is given to a child who is believed to possess the qualities of kindness, generosity, and benevolence.
